items.html: But Ima of Beriah has a complete and whole Partzuf, for the above-mentioned reason, only that she is in the aspect of Tevuna, who is short of stature as stated above. Also, there is another reason, for indeed Ima nests in Beriah as stated above, and the Keter and Hochma of Atzilut are hidden within her. Therefore they have no revelation except in the secret of VAK alone. But Ima, who is revealed as Beriah, therefore the Partzuf of Ima of Beriah is complete.
